depiction.primary_object: map location pin marker with center dot
modifiers: two concentric curved signal waves above the pin
depiction.composition: single object with overhead waves, centered front view

readings.meaning: smart tracker tag / Bluetooth beacon (AirTag, Tile)
Wi-Fi hotspot location / public Wi-Fi spot

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the pin and waves can blur into a plain Wi-Fi symbol or a lightbulb.

modifier_semantics.modifier: two concentric curved signal waves above the pin
modifier_semantics.meaning: wireless broadcast, live tracking signal, or hotspot connectivity

reasoning: The icon combines a map location pin with wireless signal waves, clearly signifying live location broadcasting, GPS/Bluetooth tracking tags (like AirTags or Tiles), geofencing, or Wi-Fi hotspots. It fits specific tasks around item trackers, family location sharing, and finding connectivity spots, though it could occasionally be confused with a plain map pin or a generic Wi-Fi symbol at very small sizes.
